speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
text: On protection for our uniformed Police officers, is there any special recourse or compensation for them, in the event that they get hurt in the course of the disorderly conduct by a member of the public?

speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
text: Our Police officers are trained to deal with different situations.

speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
text: Different circumstances may present obvious risks to the Police officers in terms of injuries.

speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
text: They always put the safety of the members of the public first, in the course of their duty.
